snippet.title: Awaking Beauty - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Awaking Beauty is a two-character action roguelite beat ’em up. Pilot dream-diving mechas, build power with randomized chips, and unleash Dream-Turbo plus a co-op Fusion Transformation to crush nightmares. Play solo or team up with a friend. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253950/Awaking_Beauty/

Developer: YOHCAN
X: https://x.com/studio_yoh

#indiegame #roguelike #beatemupgame
